m_701ddbc9e33b.en: Threefold repetition and fifty moves require a claim, including a declared intended move. Fivefold repetition and seventy-five moves end automatically; checkmate takes priority. A draw offer does not stop the clock.
m_701ddbc9e33b.zh-Hant: 三次重複與五十步須提出申請，亦可先宣告下一步後申請。五次重複與七十五步會自動和棋；同一步將死時，將死優先。提議和棋不會停止計時。

m_cb53196c708f.en: Rare dead positions and timeout mating possibilities require reliable proof. Uncertain outcomes remain Unresolved without public wins; both players may agree to a draw. This is a casual digital game, not a tournament referee.
m_cb53196c708f.zh-Hant: 罕見死局及超時後能否將死須有可靠證明。無法確認的結果維持未決，不記公開勝場；雙方仍可協議和棋。本程式供休閒對弈，不能代替賽事裁判。

m_dec2bc761ef9.en: Online clocks continue in the background. A continuous 120-second disconnection forfeits unless time expires first. Both disconnected: interrupted. Online play has no undo, hints or single-player pause.
m_dec2bc761ef9.zh-Hant: 線上用時在背景持續計算。連續斷線 120 秒判負，若時鐘先耗盡則先處理超時。雙方都斷線則中斷；線上不提供悔棋、提示或單方暫停。

m_033451a0e24d.zh-Hant: 線上西洋棋與公開戰績

m_a76ca53fc973.en: Chess uses the same private server-verified match service as Go. Match members can read the position, moves, clocks and outcome. Standard online human games publish completed games, wins, losses, draws and win rate by time control. Local games, Stockfish practice and imported positions remain private. Stockfish runs on this device without sending positions to an external AI service. Unresolved and interrupted matches do not enter public statistics. Go, Chess, Pong and shared Whiteboard share a two-active-room limit.
m_a76ca53fc973.zh-Hant: 西洋棋與圍棋共用私人且由伺服器驗證的對局服務。對局成員可讀取局面、步譜、時鐘與結果。標準線上真人局會按用時設定公開完局、勝、負、和及勝率；本機、Stockfish 練習與匯入局面維持私人。Stockfish 在此裝置執行，不會將局面傳送至外部 AI 服務。未決與中斷對局不計入公開統計。Go、Chess、Pong 與共享 Whiteboard 合計最多兩個活躍房間。

m_9d849b5de063.zh-Hant: 對應原始碼與建置說明

m_5e82554444e3.en: Timeout wins require a legal mating witness. The bounded verifier can leave ordinary middlegames as well as rare dead positions Unresolved; no public win is awarded without proof. Both players may agree to a draw. This is a casual digital game, not a tournament referee.
m_5e82554444e3.zh-Hant: 超時勝局須有合法續著可達將死的證明。驗證器的搜尋範圍有限，因此一般中局與罕見死局都有可能維持未決；未取得證明時不記公開勝場。雙方仍可協議和棋。本程式供休閒對弈，不能代替賽事裁判。

m_c795d7da04cb.en: Repetition history starts with the imported position.
m_c795d7da04cb.zh-Hant: 重複局面歷史從匯入的局面開始計算。
